categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Aofei Data Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in internet cloud computing and big data infrastructure services. Its main business includes IDC (Internet Data Center) services, other internet comprehensive services, system integration projects, distributed photovoltaic energy-saving services, and optical module sales. The company also has a growing new energy business segment focused on distributed photovoltaic power generation projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as software-defined networking (SDN) and automated operation and maintenance platforms. It builds and operates high-quality internet data centers with advanced network infrastructure supporting 5G and AI computing needs. The company also develops digital twin platforms, low-carbon intelligent computing center management platforms, multi-network aggregation acceleration platforms, distributed caching platforms, and automated operation platforms to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large and medium-sized internet enterprises across various sectors including artificial intelligence, smart manufacturing, smart healthcare, AR/VR digital creativity, e-commerce, animation and gaming, internet finance, and e-sports. The company serves customers requiring high-speed, secure, and stable internet infrastructure and cloud computing services, primarily in the digital technology industry.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with data centers in over 30 cities including Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Beijing, Langfang, Tianjin, Chengdu, Haikou, Nanning, and Nanchang. It also has overseas operations in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Germany through subsidiaries. Its data center projects are concentrated in key strategic regions such as the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aofei Data operates downstream in the telecommunications supply chain, providing IDC services and internet infrastructure by utilizing telecom operators' bandwidth and network resources. It acts as a service provider connecting multiple telecom networks and offering value-added internet services to end customers, including bandwidth and cabinet leasing, IP address rental, and content delivery network (CDN) acceleration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding its data center capacity and enhancing intelligent computing capabilities to meet growing AI and digital economy demands. It invests heavily in R&D for digital twin platforms, low-carbon intelligent computing management, multi-network aggregation, distributed caching, and automated operation platforms. It also pursues carbon neutrality and new energy strategies by integrating photovoltaic power generation into its data center operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through leasing of IDC resources such as cabinets, bandwidth, and IP addresses, as well as providing internet comprehensive services including CDN acceleration and data synchronization. Additional revenue streams include sales of computing equipment, system integration services for data center projects, and distributed photovoltaic power generation services where electricity generated is sold to customers or fed into the grid.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Aofei Data is a leading professional IDC service provider in South China with significant scale and influence. It competes with other major telecom and internet infrastructure providers by leveraging its extensive network resources, technical expertise, and comprehensive service offerings. The company maintains strong partnerships with major telecom operators like China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Mobile, positioning itself competitively in the cloud computing and data center market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.16 billion, a 62.18% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124 million, a 12.20% decrease. EBITDA grew by 34.16% to RMB 820 million. The company has expanded its data center capacity to over 43,000 cabinets and continues to invest heavily in new projects, reflecting a strong growth trajectory despite some profit margin pressure due to increased depreciation and financing costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aofei Data emphasizes providing high-quality, secure, stable, and high-speed internet infrastructure tailored to emerging digital industries' needs. Its competitive differentiation lies in its extensive multi-city data center network, advanced technology platforms (such as SDN and automated operations), and integrated digital ecosystem supporting AI, smart manufacturing, and other digital economy sectors. The company also integrates green energy solutions to align with national carbon neutrality goals, enhancing its sustainability credentials.
